pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches on the upper neck transition into smaller, more fragmented, and highly angular (stellate) geometries on the mid-to-lower flank. Edges exhibit sharp pixel gradients with significant jaggedness.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected topological graph of light-colored pathways. Interstices are widest on the neck and constrict significantly on the flank. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of short, stiff hairs against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent anatomical protrusion is visible at the withers/shoulder junction, creating a distinct angular peak in the dorsal silhouette.
